Ali Alipour.note: Alipour is an attacking change-up for IR Iran. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Ali Alipour.noteZh: 他是IR Iran的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Ali Nemati.summary: Ali Nemati is an IR Iran centre-back from Foolad FC who gives the national team left-footed defending, aerial cover, and back-line depth.
Ali Nemati.note: team has been part of IR Iran's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Ali Nemati.noteZh: 他给IR Iran后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Alireza Beiranvand.note: Beiranvand has carried the keeper minutes for IR Iran. The card is clean hands, clear restarts, and defenders who do not have to rush.
Alireza Beiranvand.noteZh: 他是IR Iran防守结构最后的声音。压力停在禁区时，他要让下一步动作简单下来。

Alireza Jahanbakhsh.note: Jahanbakhsh gives IR Iran midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Alireza Jahanbakhsh.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对IR Iran来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.summary: Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh is an IR Iran forward from Tractor FC who gives the national team quick turns, final-third carrying, and attacking spark.
Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.note: S.C is the forward IR Iran can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.noteZh: 他给IR Iran替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Amirmohammad Razaghinia.summary: Amirmohammad Razzaghinia is an IR Iran central midfielder from Esteghlal FC who gives the national team midfield legs, duel pressure, and simple progression.
Amirmohammad Razaghinia.note: Razzaghinia gives IR Iran a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Amirmohammad Razaghinia.noteZh: 他是IR Iran的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Arya Yousefi.summary: Arya Yousefi is an IR Iran right-back from Sepahan FC who gives the national team overlap timing, recovery defending, and right-side energy.
Arya Yousefi.note: G is the kind of defender IR Iran can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Arya Yousefi.noteZh: 他是IR Iran艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Danial Iri.summary: Danial Eiri is an IR Iran centre-back from Malavan Bandar Anzali who gives the national team centre-back depth, aerial defending, and box protection.
Danial Iri.note: Eiri is back-line insurance for IR Iran. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Danial Iri.noteZh: 他给IR Iran那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Dennis Dargahi.note: Ayensa is the forward IR Iran can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Dennis Dargahi.noteZh: 他给IR Iran替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Ehsan Hajisafi.note: Hajsafi gives IR Iran cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Ehsan Hajisafi.noteZh: 他是IR Iran后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Hossein Hosseini.note: Hosseini is goalkeeper cover for IR Iran. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Hossein Hosseini.noteZh: 他是IR Iran门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Hossein Kanani.note: Kanaanizadegan gives IR Iran defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Hossein Kanani.noteZh: 他是IR Iran艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Mehdi Ghayedi.summary: Mehdi Ghayedi is an IR Iran winger from Al-Nasr SC who gives the national team low-centre turns, inside shots, and left-wing dribbling.
Mehdi Ghayedi.note: winners gives IR Iran a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Mehdi Ghayedi.noteZh: 他是IR Iran在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Mehdi Taremi.note: Taremi is one of IR Iran's attacking paths this tournament. Watch how the first defender reacts when he receives facing goal.
Mehdi Taremi.noteZh: 他现在会出现在对手的赛前报告里。对IR Iran来说，他的触球可以把协防从下一个跑动上拉走。

Mehdi Torabi.note: Torabi gives IR Iran a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Mehdi Torabi.noteZh: 他是IR Iran在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Milad Mohammadi.note: Mohammadi| is defensive rotation for IR Iran. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
Milad Mohammadi.noteZh: 他是IR Iran后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Mohammad Ghorbani.summary: Mohammad Ghorbani is an IR Iran defensive midfielder from Al-Wahda FC who gives the national team central coverage, ball winning, and midfield size.
Mohammad Ghorbani.note: Iran is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For IR Iran, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Mohammad Ghorbani.noteZh: 他给IR Iran提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Mohammad Mohebbi.note: Mohebi's World Cup has already included a goal against New Zealand. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Mohammad Mohebbi.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Payam Niazmand.note: Niazmand gives IR Iran a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Payam Niazmand.noteZh: 他在IR Iran首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Ramin Rezaeian.note: Rezaeian has given IR Iran both the finish and the pass, including goals against New Zealand and Egypt. That double threat is why defenders cannot settle on one answer.
Ramin Rezaeian.noteZh: 他已经把进球和助攻都放进了IR Iran的赛事故事里。看点是第一脚之后，第二个动作有多快。

Roozbeh Cheshmi.note: Cheshmi gives IR Iran cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.

Saeid Ezatolahi.note: Ezatolahi has been one of IR Iran's players who keeps possessions from fraying. The detail to watch is how early he knows the next pass.
Saeid Ezatolahi.noteZh: 他是IR Iran这届赛事中的中场连接点之一。他让下一脚传球继续存在，也帮助球队避免仓促选择。

Saleh Hardani.note: Hardani gives IR Iran cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Saleh Hardani.noteZh: 他是IR Iran后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Saman Ghoddos.noteZh: 他是IR Iran主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Shahriyar Moghanloo.note: Moghanlou is attacking depth for IR Iran. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Shahriyar Moghanloo.noteZh: 他是IR Iran前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。
